'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Islamist insurgency in the Sahel]]
**[[Mali War]]
***[[September 2023 Mali attacks]]
****[[Islamic extremism|Islamist]] [[insurgent]]s attack a [[military camp]] and a [[riverboat]] in northeast [[Mali]]. Sixty-four people are killed during the attacks, including 49 [[civilian]]s and fifteen troops. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-66747884 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-49-civilians-15-soldiers-killed-north-east-mali-attacks-interim-government-2023-09-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] enter the [[Ghost town|deserted]] villages of [[Stroivka, Kharkiv Oblast|Stroivka]] and [[Topoli (rural-type settlement), Dvorichna settlement hromada, Kupiansk Raion, Kharkiv Oblast|Topoli]] at the [[Russia–Ukraine border]] in [[Kharkiv Oblast]]. The villages were abandoned by [[Russia]] after the [[2022 Kharkiv counteroffensive]] but [[Ukraine]] was previously unable to enter the villages due to the presence of [[Explosive mine|mines]] in the area. [https://kyivindependent.com/border-guards-raise-flags-in-kharkiv-oblast-gray-zone-settlements-near-russian-border/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Anglophone Crisis]]
**Three civilians are killed when armed [[separatist]]s attack vehicles in [[Muea]], [[Southwest Region (Cameroon)|Southwest Region]], [[Cameroon]]. Armed militants stopped cars, shot at passengers and set vehicles on fire during the attack.  [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/cameroon-militants-set-cars-fire-shoot-passengers-village-attack-2023-09-07/ (Reuters)] [https://www.africanews.com/2023/09/07/cameroon-at-least-three-killed-in-attack-blamed-on-separatist-rebels/ (Africanews)]
*[[Ethnic violence in South Sudan]]
**Two farmers are killed and one is injured after an attack by unknown armed men in [[Eastern Equatoria]], [[South Sudan]]. The victims were returning home when the attack occurred. [https://www.radiotamazuj.org/en/news/article/e-equatoria-2-killed-1-injured-in-imehejek-revenge-attack (Radio Tamazuj)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Six civilians are shot dead on a [[fronton (court)|fronton court]] near the downtown of [[Guadalupe, Zacatecas|Guadalupe]], Zacatecas. Hours later other armed attacks leave two more people dead. [https://www.elsoldezacatecas.com.mx/local/municipios/de-entre-22-y-57-anos-las-edades-de-las-victimas-de-masacre-en-guadalupe-zacatecas-10662069.html (''El Sol de Zacatecas'')] [https://www.elsoldezacatecas.com.mx/local/matan-a-una-mujer-y-un-hombre-en-ataques-armados-en-guadalupe-10657209.html (''El Sol de Zacatecas'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[China]] bans the use of [[iPhones]] for [[Government of China|government]] officials resulting in the [[market value]] of [[Apple Inc.]] [[stock]] declining by [[United States dollar|$]]200 billion in the past two days. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/06/tech/china-government-official-iphone-ban/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-09-07/apple-poised-to-shed-194-billion-as-china-broadens-iphone-ban?srnd=premium#xj4y7vzkg (Bloomberg)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Southeast Europe floods]]
**The death toll from the [[flood]]s in [[Turkey]], [[Bulgaria]], and [[Greece]] increases to 15 after five more people are found dead in Greece. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/7/death-toll-rises-to-four-in-greece-after-floods-more-than-800-rescued (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[Motorway 1 (Greece)|main highway]] between [[Athens]] and [[Thessaloniki]] is closed due to flooding. [[Rail transport in Greece|Passenger train service]] between the two cities is also suspended. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2489537-dodental-door-overstromingen-in-griekenland-turkije-en-bulgarije-loopt-op (NOS)]
*[[2023 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Lee (2023)|Hurricane Lee]] strengthens into a [[category 5 hurricane]], with [[maximum sustained winds]] of 165 mph, traveling west-northwest towards the [[Leeward Islands]] and [[Puerto Rico]]. [https://www.npr.org/2023/09/07/1198147021/hurricane-lee-forecast-category-5-storm (NPR)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United Kingdom–European Union relations]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] announces that it will rejoin [[Horizon Europe]], a [[European Union]] [[scientific research]] initiative. The UK had been excluded for the past three years due to disagreement over the [[Northern Ireland Protocol]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-66737714 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
**[[Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
***Former [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] [[White House National Trade Council|economic adviser]] [[Peter Navarro]] is found guilty of [[Contempt of Congress|contempt]] of [[United States Congress|Congress]] for failing to comply with a congressional subpoena issued by the [[January 6th Committee|January 6 committee]] investigating the [[United States Capitol|U.S. Capitol]] [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|attack]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna103790 (NBC News)]

The suspected [[serial killer]] lured his victims to his house from nearby [[Bar (establishment)|bars]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/7/rwanda-police-arrest-serial-killer-suspect-after-finding-bodies-in-kitchen (Al Jazeera)]
*Japanese pop agency [[Johnny & Associates]] publicly admits and apologizes for [[Johnny Kitagawa sexual abuse scandal|sexual abuses on several hundred minors]] committed by its late founder [[Johnny Kitagawa]].
